title: Prompt + Quantization Sprint Scratchpad
content:
2025-10-06 — sprint scratchpad (running list, half-baked thoughts)

Top goal: finish baseline eval matrix for 4-bit GPTQ on vicuna-13b-like checkpoint and collect prompt-sensitivity traces. Need clean runs to compare to our hosted API numbers (latency + acceptability).

Quick daily TODO
- [ ] launch 8 parallel eval jobs on prod-dedicated (small batch) with prefix caching ON for a subset of prompts
- [ ] instrument KV cache hit rate logging in the runner (samir/kv-hits branch) — add csv output per-run
- [ ] rerun prompt variant A3 (few-shot) with temperature .2/.7 for hallucination check
- [ ] doc: example prompts and scoring rubric for human raters (draft)
- [ ] sync with Noah 10:30am re: quantized model divergence (short meeting)

Notes on current experiments
- Experiment group: vicuna-13b-ish (hf-weights patched to our internal layout). Two quant stacks: GPTQ int4 (per-channel) and static int8 (symmetric). Also trying hybrid: attention int8 / MLP int4.
- Hypothesis: GPTQ-int4 will keep pass rate ~95% on short prompts (<128) but degrade on longer context due to KV cache mismatch + rounding accumulation.
- Observed: early run (2025-10-04) showed answer truncation in ~3% of cases when sequence len > 512. Repro steps: run id gptq-run-20251004-17.

Run matrix (planned)
- seeds: [42, 99, 123]
- batch_sizes: [1,4,8]
- max_len: [128, 512, 1024]
- quant: [fp16 (baseline), gptq-int4, static-int8, hybrid-attn8-mlp4]
- prompt variants: [A0-empty, A1-single-shot, A2-zero-shot, A3-few-shot (3 examples), A4-system-instruction-heavy]
- metrics: latency P50/P90, tokens/s, pass_rate (automated eval), human_accept_rate (sampled 50 per cell), hallucination_flag_rate

Prompt engineering notes (variants + quick rationale)
- A0-empty: baseline short question, no context. Purpose: measure raw model behavior after quant.
- A1-single-shot: one exemplar to set format. Check if quantization screws format copying.
- A2-zero-shot: catch off-by-default behaviors.
- A3-few-shot: sanity for instruction-following; sometimes reduces hallucinations.
- A4-system: long instruction to encourage conservative answers — watch for token blowup.

Quick prompt examples (copy-paste for runner)
- A0: "Summarize the following paragraph in one sentence: <PARA>"
- A3: "Example: Q: What color is the sun? A: Yellow.
Q: <INPUT> A:"
- Note: trim examples to <80 tokens to keep shot overhead small.

Scoring heuristics (automated)
- pass_rate auto: exact-match for format + BLEU threshold 0.45 for content similarity for factual prompts.
- hallucination detection: entity mismatch vs gold facts (simple NER comparison) + hallucination score if unsupported assertions > 0.2 (heuristic).
- human sampler: random 50 per cell, rubric: 0 unacceptable, 1 minor issues, 2 acceptable. Aim: human_accept_rate >= 0.85 for product-ready.

Quantization gotchas to check
- KV reorder: GPTQ tool we used (gptq-scaler v0.9) rewrites weight layout; ensure runtime kernel handles cached keys in same ordering. Potential source of truncation.
- Softmax stability: low-precision in attention can cause occasional nan/s or very peaky distribution -> test with tiny temp = 1e-6 guard.
- Layernorm ordering differences: small fp16 vs int4/8 ops can change numerical path; add a deterministic seed and compare layer outputs on first 50 tokens.

Runner commands (cheat sheet)
- launch: ./run_eval.sh --model vicuna-13b-ourpatch --quant gptq4 --prompts prompts/a3.json --out runs/gptq-a3-$(date +%Y%m%d)-s$SEED.csv --max-len 512 --batch 4
- compare: python compare_traces.py --baseline runs/fp16-a3-... --candidate runs/gptq-a3-... --metrics latency, pass_rate, tokens

Bugs / open questions
- BUG-1: memory leak in runner when batch_size>4 + prefix caching ON. Repro: see run gptq-mem-20250929. Heap growth ~200MB/1k requests. Investigate pinned tensors not freed.
- Q: should we enable per-request KV priming flush for quantized variants? Tradeoff: flush reduces cache reuse but may avoid stale ordering bugs. Try a quick A/B.

Human review checklist (for sampled outputs)
- readability (yes/no)
- hallucination visible (yes/no)
- format match (yes/no)
- confidence score (1-5)

Next actions (short)
1) run full matrix for A0/A3 small config (batch 1/4, max_len 128/512) by EOD 2025-10-07. Tag runs with JIRA-AML-1923.
2) pair-debug with Noah on KV ordering (today 10:30). Goal: repro the truncation locally with debug prints.
3) draft human rubric doc and push to confluence stub (samir/aml/rubrics) — include sampling plan.
4) if memory leak persists, roll back prefix caching for quantized jobs and note performance delta.

Random scribbles
- idea: try mixed-precision caching — store KV in fp16 even if compute is int4 (might stabilize acc). Feels messy but cheap to test.
- note to self: re-check tokenizer behavior (byte pair differences) between HF tokenizer and our runtime token indices — could cause off-by-one length differences.

END — will iterate.
